recovery_action.description: The operation was reconfigured after containment and prepared for a new bounded authority decision.

reason: Recovery processing completed with independent verification and fresh authority, but no explicit final recovery state was recorded.

violations.name: Recovery Final State Missing
violations.reason: The Recovery Receipt does not declare an explicit resulting state, so downstream systems cannot determine the authoritative outcome of recovery.

SAFETY-INV-018.reason: The Recovery Receipt identifies the HELD source state and originating Containment Receipt.

SAFETY-INV-019.reason: The previous authority was not restored and a new reduced Authority Envelope was issued.

SAFETY-INV-020.reason: No explicit final_state is present in the Recovery Receipt.

risk.reason: Without an explicit final state, different components may interpret the recovery outcome differently.

required_actions: reject the Recovery Receipt as incomplete
do not infer the final state from the presence of a new Authority Envelope
keep execution blocked until the recovery outcome is explicit
declare exactly one valid final recovery state
link that final state to the verification and authority outcome
record the corrected Recovery Receipt in trace
allow downstream systems to act only after the final state is explicit
